# FLX-7012: prediction interval has its low above its high

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

A prediction's declared interval runs from interval_low to interval_high, so the low may not be above the high. An interval whose ends are reversed has a negative width, contains no value, and would score as if it were wider than any real interval. A low equal to the high is a point interval and is accepted. `fluxsim accuracy register` and `fluxsim forecast make` refuse such a record before anything is written, and a record already in the store that holds one is refused when it is read, naming the record. Swap the two values, or leave both out.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7012
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
